narr: Surface high pressure was solidly over central Kentucky, but given the moist atmosphere and temperatures in the 90s, afternoon and evening thunderstorms resulted in a variety of severe thunderstorm damage across central Kentucky. Reports ranged from flash flooding and wind damage to a couple of lightning fires.
ev: Two cars were stranded in flood waters. Cost of damage is unknown.
lsr: TWO CARS STRANDED IN FLOODED ROADWAY; PEOPLE STRANDED ON CARS AT 13TH AND MARKET STREETS IN LOUISVILLE. REPORT RELAYED VIA TWITTER.
